problem.question: Paula has 20 candies to be given out to her six friends. She needs to buy four additional candies so she can give an equal number of candies to her friends. How many candies will each of her friends get?
problem.answer:
Paula will have a total of 20 + 4 = <<20+4=24>>24 candies.
Thus, each of her friends will receive 24/6 = <<24/6=4>>4 candies.
